channel.title: The Signal · AI News & Ideas
channel.description: Original AI news explainers with primary-source links.

item.title: OpenAI opens a new AI research pathway for academic labs
item.description: The Rosalind Academic Plan offers eligible US university labs sponsored access to a specialized life-sciences model. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-rosalind-academic-plan/

item.title: Anthropic expands access for independent AI evaluators
item.description: METR receives deeper access for risk assessment as Anthropic outlines its approach to outside scrutiny. Original source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-independent-evaluators

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon puts cyberdefense and safety in the spotlight
item.description: Google says its latest frontier model underwent a staged security rollout, with defenders receiving early access. Original source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/safety-security/gemini-4-model-safety-security/

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon moves into the Gemini app
item.description: Google expands access to its frontier reasoning model and adds new ways to move from conversation to tasks. Original source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-4-argon-availability/

item.title: When an AI agent goes off-script: lessons from Anthropic’s tests
item.description: A candid report of agents bypassing restrictions and taking unintended actions makes the case for stronger tool controls. Original source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/investigating-unintended-model-actions

item.title: Anthropic launches a cyber mission for critical systems
item.description: A new initiative targets defensive security for critical infrastructure and open-source software. Original source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-cyber-mission

item.title: GPT-6 is turning answers into interactive experiences
item.description: OpenAI introduces Intelligent UI, making visual and interactive responses part of the ChatGPT experience. Original source: https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/

item.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 makes the case for fast, focused AI
item.description: Anthropic positions its new small model around lower-cost repetitive tasks, high-volume usage and speed-sensitive applications. Original source: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-haiku-5-5

item.title: OpenAI publishes AI-generated mathematics for scrutiny
item.description: New mathematical results and formal proofs are shared with the research community for assessment and further work. Original source: https://openai.com/index/sharing-ai-progress-in-mathematics/

item.title: DevDay 2026: the bigger story is how developers build with agents
item.description: OpenAI’s developer event put models, collaboration surfaces and persistent agents on one stage. Original source: https://openai.com/index/devday-2026-recap/

item.title: GPT-6.1 Sol asks a practical question: how much intelligence can you afford?
item.description: OpenAI positions Sol as a lower-priced route to capabilities approaching its larger Astra model. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-sol/

item.title: OpenAI’s Dots point toward AI that works between conversations
item.description: Always-on personal agents bring persistence, connected apps and ongoing tasks into the product conversation. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-dots/

item.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 raises the bar for everyday agent work
item.description: Anthropic says its latest Sonnet is faster and more economical for many coding and document workflows. Original source: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-5

item.title: Three speeds of intelligence: inside OpenAI’s GPT-6 family
item.description: Astra, Sol and Luna illustrate why model selection is becoming a workload decision rather than a simple ranking. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna/

item.title: Gemini 3 predicted a future where interfaces adapt to the question
item.description: Google introduced generative interfaces and experimental agent features alongside Gemini 3. Original source: https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/gemini-3-gemini-app/

item.title: The GPT-5 moment: when fast answers and deeper reasoning came together
item.description: OpenAI’s 2025 release helped normalize the idea of one assistant choosing when to think longer. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/

item.title: From chatting to doing: why ChatGPT agent was a turning point
item.description: The 2025 announcement brought browser actions, research and multi-step tasks into a single assistant. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-agent/

item.title: AlphaGenome is teaching AI to read the regulatory language of DNA
item.description: A research model predicts how changes in genome sequences may affect biological function. Original source: https://deepmind.google/blog/alphagenome-ai-for-better-understanding-the-genome/

item.title: When image generation learned to follow a design brief
item.description: GPT-4o’s 2025 image release emphasized readable text and more useful instruction-following. Original source: https://openai.com/index/introducing-4o-image-generation/

item.title: MCP made connecting AI to real tools a shared engineering problem
item.description: Anthropic’s open protocol helped establish a common language between assistants and data sources. Original source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol

item.title: AI designed the chips that help power AI: the AlphaChip story
item.description: Google DeepMind described how reinforcement learning was used to improve chip layouts. Original source: https://deepmind.google/blog/how-alphachip-transformed-computer-chip-design/

item.title: AlphaFold 3 showed what happens when AI starts modeling molecular interactions
item.description: DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs extended structure prediction from proteins toward molecular complexes. Original source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/google-deepmind-isomorphic-alphafold-3-ai-model/
